title: Progression Models in Resistance Training for Healthy Adults
text: For muscular hypertrophy, the ACSM recommends that novice and intermediate individuals perform 1-3 sets per exercise using a loading of 70-85% of their 1-repetition maximum (1RM) for 8-12 repetitions. Advanced individuals should use 3-6 sets per exercise with 70-100% 1RM for 1-12 repetitions. Rest periods of 1-2 minutes are recommended for novice/intermediate training, while advanced training using heavy loads should incorporate 2-3 minute rest periods. Training frequency should be 2-3 days per week for novices, progressing to 4-5 days per week for advanced trainees using split routines.
